caption: The drawing depicts a round, wide-mouthed stoneware jar with two looped handles on opposite sides near the rim. The jar has a mottled brown and beige surface with darker brown spots and a slightly shiny texture, indicating it is glazed. On the front of the jar, there is a prominent blue decorative motif that resembles a stylized leaf or floral design. The background is plain and off-white, and a rectangular border frames the jar. In the upper left corner, there is a torn, beige-colored label inscribed with "J. REMMEY MANHATTAN-WELLS NEW-YORK" in blue capital letters. At the lower left, there is a faint signature that reads "Yplande Delasse" in cursive.
